Section 7 Acceptance criteria, the Given line of any criterion that reaches another service (dependency class C)

A story builds against the published contract of the other service and its fake, never against the other service at run time. The Given names the fake and the Then names the published response. Source: Template and Rules section R5.4 class C, section R5.5 DP-11, section R7.2 section 12.8.

Section 16 Test cases; the TC ID column

Questions this work package leaves open
Thai wording of the new rows
The Thai cell of the three new rows holds the placeholder of section R9. Read the English cell until the Thai wording is confirmed.
Origin tag where one legacy criterion is carried by several new stories
The tag always names the legacy story and the criterion number, unchanged, and is repeated in every new story that carries the criterion.
Name, version and location of a contract fake
The fake is called 'the <service> contract fake'. Its artefact name, version and repository location are not specified in the source documents.
Level and register place of an -ITG copy
The integration copy is a separate row at Level Integration or End to end; the plain ID stays on the unit, component and contract copy.
